title: Build a Union-Find (Disjoint Set Union) in Go
description: Greenfield Go task: implement Union-Find with path compression and union-by-rank, supporting Find, Union, Connected, and Count operations.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement Union-Find in internal/uf/uf.go.

package uf

type UnionFind struct {
    parent []int
    rank   []int
    count  int
}

func New(n int) *UnionFind   // n nodes, each is its own component
func (uf *UnionFind) Find(x int) int          // with path compression
func (uf *UnionFind) Union(x, y int)          // union-by-rank; no-op if already connected
func (uf *UnionFind) Connected(x, y int) bool // true if same component
func (uf *UnionFind) Count() int              // number of distinct components

Path compression: on Find, update each node to point directly to the root.
Union-by-rank: attach the tree with smaller rank under the one with larger rank.

All 6 tests in internal/uf/uf_test.go must pass.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: UnionFind struct with parent, rank, count fields
New initializes each node as its own parent
Union uses union-by-rank and decrements count
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
